Name: Seasonal Special Order Board Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3][color=#fce5cd]Dunno about you but for me it always been an eyesore to see the vanilla special order board with my environment recolors. So I tried to fix it![/color]

The appearance of the board depends of season, weather and events.

Currently 4 options available to match [color=#fce5cd][b]Foliage Redone[/b] [/color]and [b][color=#fce5cd]Yellog's Town Overhaul[/color] [/b](since I personally use these two alot):
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Vanilla[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Dark[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Dark1[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]White[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=2][u][b]Please, If you find any bug, tell me and I will fix it!
[/b][/u]Should be compatible with android
If you want, you can use my assets and upload standalone mod that match other recolors like VPR.[/size]
[/font][center][/center]

Downloads.Description:
adjusted some colors
added board texture for Night Market
festival board textures now will be visible the day before the festivals
